reference: Right jaw minus left jaw defines x. y points down perpendicular to jaw line. Origin midpoint of visible jaw tip landmarks. Recess centre and visible upper outline chord in pixels/degrees. The chord is sampled at 87 pixel span. Delta is relative to median of valid last seven grasp frames, requiring four.
clock: Elapsed seconds since first commanded row, original map_camera_clock applied within host receipt command interval ±0.5 s. Full-capture rejection preserved. Offline timing excludes interpreter startup and supplemental audits.
holdout_policy: Existing phase annotations selected the two lift positives. Scored once, no threshold changes after freeze. Physical success is not ground truth of no movement.
